leadText:
A Madame (Japanese: マダム Madame), known as a Socialite until Generation VI, is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation IV. They are depicted as rich, older women wearing exquisite clothing and accessories. Madames will generally use Pokémon based on pets or other "refined" Pokémon, like .

In the Battle Subway in Generation V, Socialites specialize in Legendary Pokémon during later battles.

In Generation VI, this only appears in the Battle Maison, but Madames can also be found in at the Battle Chateau as a , , , , or . Their male counterparts appear to be the and classes.

In Generations and , they keep their Pokémon in Luxury Balls. In the Battle Tree, Madames who appear after the will primarily use Legendary Pokémon.
